name: Fire Emblem: Three Houses

cuts.why: per-render-mode present interval table {2,1,2,2,1,2} → all 1 (60 fps; the game logic already runs at 60 updates a second)
per-render-mode interval as float {2.0,1.0,2.0,2.0,1.0,2.0} → all 1.0 (render-thread per-frame steps)
render thread forced interval 2: orr w8,w9,w8 (either flag) → mov w8,wzr (the mode's interval, 1)
render thread wait timeout: fmov s1,#1.0 → adrp x8,#0xcb7000
render thread wait timeout: fdiv s0,s1,s0 → ldr s8,[x8,#0xb50] (1000.0)
render thread wait timeout: adrp x8,#0xcb7000 → fdiv s0,s8,s0 (1000/fps; the fmul by s8 that follows makes it µs)
render thread wait timeout: ldr s8,[x8,#0xb50] → nop (moved up)

address_space.note: the profile reserves heap 3.25 GB, alias 0.25 GB, stack 0.25 GB with a pool of 3.21 GB; this process has heap 3.15 GB, alias 0.25 GB, stack 0.06 GB: everything the pool lets the game commit fits, with less spare address space than nxnative gives it
